title: hospital, babies
content: i only vaguely remember the hospital but it wasn't totally abandoned but perhaps mostly still up and running kind of disheveled, top floor. i've never given birth in the hospital like a lot of people have so this was my first time. i gave birth to my first she was so small like could fit in my hand. i put her in a tank like its about the size of a bearded dragon tank but nothing was in it other than a flat like i guess crib mattress. the baby didn't cry. there were guys in lab coats watching the baby writing stuff down. very briefly. i only remember seeing them once. then by surprise i gave birth to another. she was bigger but not full sized. i put her in the tank next to the other one. first baby did not make it /: i felt sad but understanding. they just stayed in the tank. i'd take them out to feed. they were so weird. idk. my dad was there, he's dead and in a lot of my dreams lately, wanted to hang out with me and my tank babies.
